chunks: When he asked his father and his people: "What do you worship?"
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Hud ask his father and people regarding their worship?
ai.summary: In the Shia exegetical tradition, this verse is often cited as a model for *da'wah* (invitation to God), demonstrating how Prophet Hud employed rational inquiry to challenge the blind adherence to ancestral traditions (*taqlid*). It underscores the transition from polytheism to pure monotheism (*tawhid*) by questioning the very essence of the objects of worship, a theme central to the Prophetic mission in Surah Al-Shu'ara.
